description: MCP Secure deterministic policy ruleset v2. This file's SHA-256 is stored in every ScanRecord to guarantee reproducibility. v2 adds astSeverityScores, which map the real AST taint analyzer's severity tiers onto the 0-1 analyzer score the policy engine consumes.
astSeverityScoresRationale: high -> 1.0 trips astHardFail (>=0.6) for an immediate FAIL: unsanitized tainted data reaching a shell/exec sink within 2 hops. medium -> 0.55 sits above the review threshold (0.40) but below both the hard-fail gate and the fail threshold, so indirect flows and dynamic/file/deserialize sinks route to the REVIEW tier for human confirmation rather than auto-rejection. low -> 0.25 is a sanitized flow: reported as evidence, never verdict-changing on its own.

AST_TAINT.description: Command injection via tainted sink reachability. A single confirmed hit causes an immediate FAIL regardless of other analyzers.

MODEL_A_TEXT.description: Simulated fine-tuned text model detecting tool-poisoning and prompt-manipulation attacks (PMA) in tool descriptions.

MODEL_B_CODE.description: Simulated fine-tuned code model detecting obfuscated command injection patterns that static AST analysis misses.
